name: Yakushimaru Ryota
source: The party-goer among the Summoners. Ryota is a kind and friendly individual who is popular with friends from other academies, mostly with those from the Daikanyama Academy where he also regularly helps out with their charity projects. Though his taste in food is excellent, his talent in cooking isn't.
